title: baba teri sakina har zulm seh rahi hai
body:
baba teri sakina har zulm seh rahi hai
<<MINI>>
maa fatima zehra ki tasveer bann gayi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
1. darvaza jal gaya tha tab fatima ke ghar ka, ab khaimein jal rahe hai manzar wahi hai baba, daman bhi jal gaya hai chader bhi chin chuki hai.
<<MINI>>
maa fatima zehra ki tasveer bann gayi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
2. durre lagaye mujh par khaye hai taziyaneh, dadi ki tarha mujhpar barsa gaye tamachay, kal ka woh saneha tha rudad ye nayi hai.
<<MINI>>
maa fatima zehra ki tasveer bann gayi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
3. dono hue yateem aaur dono ko baap ka gham, dono ne zalimo se chup kar kiya hai matam, dono kay gham mein duniya aansu baha rahi hai.
<<MINI>>
maa fatima zehra ki tasveer bann gayi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
4. pehlu mein fatima kay mohsin ko maar dala, haatho pe teray baba asghar ne teer khaya, asghar ke khoo se khoshboo mohsin ki aa rahi hai.
<<MINI>>
maa fatima zehra ki tasveer bann gayi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
5. zakhmi hai kaan meray zakhmi hai mera chehra, balon se lag rahi hoon baba main ek zaieefa, jo fatima pe guzri mujhpar guzar rahi hai.
<<MINI>>
maa fatima zahra ki tasveer bann gayi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
6. main oont se zamee par rahon mein girr rahi
hoon, dadi kay dard ko mai apna bana chuki hoon, meri bhi phasliyo se awaaz aa rahi hai.
<<MINI>>
maa fatima zahra ki tasveer bann gayi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
7. hakim ne tab kiya tha taoheen syeda ki, touheen yeh kar rahe hai baba ye abb tumhari, woh sakht imtehan tha yeh sabr ki ghadi hai.
<<MINI>>
maa fatima zahra ki tasveer bann gayi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
8. tarikh mein milega na koi kam sini mein, bann jaye yu zaeefa ek din ki roshini mein, bas aik fatima aur ek ladili teri hai.
<<MINI>>
maa fatima zahra ki tasveer bann gayi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
9. darbaar e aam mein woh darbaar e aam me
main, zindaan e jaa me woh thi zindaan e shaam me main, woh unki be-kasi thi ye meri be-basi hai.
<<MINI>>
maa fatima zahra ki tasveer bann gayi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
10. guzri thi jabke zahra baba the tum bhi kamsin, wirsay me main ne tumsay yeh dard paya lekin, tab tum toh jee gaye thay beti yeh marr rahi hai.
<<MINI>>
maa fatima zahra ki tasveer bann gayi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
11. kehta hai akhtari yeh sar peet kar raza se, aao chale madina gham shaam ka sunanay, rokar kahengay bibi kya zulm aaj bhi hai.
<<MINI>>
maa fatima zahra ki tasveer bann gayi hai
